$comment: What this milestone ships (BUILD_PLAN 3.6, 10.6). S2 writes the screens, the main block and the channel swap; S3 adds the guest book and the trail (preview only: main.screens keeps them off main); S4 adds the shows-and-hides switches. screens: the screens this build has (a line on another screen waits for it: T11). main.screens: the screens the main channel carries. main.off: lines on those screens that main leaves out, each with its reason; the fill removes them, and T14 holds every other line main reaches to the ledger. channels: per-channel id swaps for the fill.
